children: Oppenheimer Holdings reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $382.0 million, down 10.0% year over year, and net income attributable to the company of $5.5 million, compared with $21.7 million a year earlier. Basic earnings per share were $0.52, while adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.81. Results included a $21.0 million pre-tax expense tied to stock appreciation rights.
Revenue was $382.0 million, down 10.0% from $424.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. Nine-month revenue rose 10.0% to $1.282 billion.
Pre-tax income was $8.8 million, compared with $31.6 million in the prior-year quarter.
Net income attributable to Oppenheimer Holdings was $5.5 million, or $0.52 per basic share, versus $21.7 million, or $2.06 per basic share, a year earlier.
Adjusted net income was $20.9 million, compared with $31.7 million in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $1.81, compared with $2.77 in the third quarter of 2025.

Wealth Management revenue increased 2.5% year over year. Advisory fees grew 15.3%, supported by higher average assets under management, while retail commissions declined 13.9% amid lower trading activity.

Assets under management reached a record $59.6 billion at September 30, up $4.5 billion year over year; higher asset values were partly offset by net distributions. Assets under administration were $153.7 billion.

Capital Markets revenue fell 29.7% year over year, and the segment recorded a pre-tax loss. Lower investment banking activity reflected fewer advisory and underwriting transactions; equities sales and trading revenue increased while fixed-income sales and trading revenue declined.
Financial advisor headcount was 926 at quarter-end, compared with 927 a year earlier. The company reported record stockholders’ equity of $991.1 million.
The board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share, payable November 27, 2026, to shareholders of record November 13, 2026.

title: Oppenheimer Holdings Q3 Revenue Falls 10% as Net Income Drops to $5.5 Million
